Implementation Plan I'm planning an automatic, once-per-head resume for projects that failed only because the final merge ran out of attempts. It follows the existing security-pass auto reset pattern. PLANNING REF: `main` at `6723f30393cb97d9f0d2459ee7364b06be99f470`. The integration branch mismatch flag reads `unknown`, not `true`, so planning continues. Default-branch reference `isolated-base` is present. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` - `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` - `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_workflow_contract.py` - `README.md` - `changelog.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md` (new) - `agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md` (new) ## Automation surface (§20.E) - This only changes existing code. There is no new script, workflow, supervisor or DB work, and nothing goes into `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`. - Entry point: the existing scheduled poller, `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (schedule and dispatch triggers), which runs `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`. The only workflow change is one env line per poller job so the repo variable can turn the switch off. - No new long-running supervisor. ## Conflicts between the issue and the code 1. **"Project already failed, skipping."** is not a literal string in the script. The terminal block (around lines 28763–28803) prints `echo "Project already ${PROJECT_STATUS}, skipping."` at line 28802. The `ai:force-merge` bypass sits just above it, at lines 28782–28789. 2. **Nothing to reuse for API cost.** The issue says to reuse PR and check-run data the terminal block and `_summarize_final_merge_blockers` (line 1756) already fetch. In fact the terminal block fetches no PR data except inside the bypass, which only runs when the `ai:force-merge` label is set. `_summarize_final_merge_blockers` runs only on the ineligibility-alert path, never in the terminal block. 3. **More calls than the issue's budget.** The issue allows one PR read and one check-run read per project per tick, but the helpers it requires make more calls: - `_pr_checks_completed` with a base ref calls `_pr_required_check_names_for_base`, which adds one branch-protection read. - `compute_cycle_integration_ahead_by` adds a default-branch read and a compare call. - Worst case per qualifying project per tick: 1 PR read, 1 protection read, 1 paginated check-runs read, 1 repo read and 1 compare. - Mitigation: these run only after every free check has passed (switch, failure kind, validation record, head not already retried). Other projects make no calls. 4. **Head SHA at exhaustion is not in scope.** `mark_validation_complete` (line 16843) has no final-PR head SHA in scope when it exhausts. `_security_final_pr_json` is only fetched when the security pass is on. The head is read inside `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed` (local `pr_head_sha`, around line 14055) and is exported through a new global so the exhaustion path can record it without a new call. 5. **"Validation passed and was recorded".** The plan uses `validation_last_passed_sha`, which `mark_validation_complete` writes (#8232, lines 16887–16895). Other `failed` paths also set `final_merge_status = "failed"` (lines 6119, 6128, 12568, 13334, 13468). That is why a dedicated state field is needed and why legacy states are not inferred (D2). ## Functions or modules to implement In `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`: 1. **Switch parsing**, next to the `SECURITY_PASS_AUTO_RESET_ON_ENGINE_CHANGE` block (around line 2604), with the same `is_truthy "${FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED:-true}"` normalisation to `true`/`false`. Add a comment citing fun-token-multi-chain#579/#596. The default lives in the script itself (§8). 2. **`finalize_integration_merge_if_needed`** (line 13792): - set `FINAL_MERGE_LAST_PR_HEAD_SHA=""` at entry, next to `FINAL_MERGE_BUDGET_ELIGIBLE="1"`; - set it from `pr_head_sha` once that resolves to 40-hex (around line 14055). - The implementer must grep that the name is unused (§10). 3. **`mark_validation_complete`**: - Exhaustion jq (lines 16929–16933): also write `.final_merge_failure_kind = "final_merge_exhausted"`, `.final_merge_exhausted_head_sha = $sha` (40-hex or `""`) and `.final_merge_exhausted_at_utc` (UTC ISO-8601). - Success jq (around lines 16958–16968): add `| .final_merge_failure_kind = null` so a completed project never keeps the marker. 4. **New `maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted`**, placed after `maybe_apply_force_merge_bypass` (line 10617). It returns 0 when it resumed (the caller does `continue`) and 1 otherwise. It reads `STATE_FILE`, `TRACKING_NUM` and `TRACKING_LABELS`. Checks run cheapest first. Each failing check logs `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME tracking_issue= outcome=skip reason=` (with `detail=` only where shown) and returns 1: | Order | Check | Skip reason | |---|---|---| | a | Switch is not `true` | `disabled` | | b | `.final_merge_failure_kind == "final_merge_exhausted"`, `.final_merge_status == "failed"`, and `TRACKING_LABELS` has none of `ai:validation-failed`, `ai:validate-failed`, `ai:security-pass-failed`. A state read that fails gives `lookup_failed detail=state` instead. | `not_final_merge_exhausted` | | c | `.final_merge_pr` is numeric and `.integration_branch` is non-empty | `lookup_failed detail=state` | | d | `.validation_last_passed_sha` is 40-hex | `validation_stale detail=missing` | | e | `_fetch_pr_json` returns `{}` or no 40-hex `.head.sha` | `lookup_failed detail=pr` | | e | `.head.ref` is not the integration branch | `lookup_failed detail=head_ref_mismatch` | | f | `.state != "open"` or `.draft == true` | `pr_not_open` | | g | Head is already in `.final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas` | `already_resumed_on_head` (adds `head_sha=`) | | h | Head differs from `validation_last_passed_sha` (D3) | `validation_stale detail=head_mismatch` | | i | `.mergeable != true` (null too) or `.mergeable_state != "clean"` | `not_mergeable` | | j | `_pr_checks_completed ` fails with `PR_CHECKS_LAST_REASON == "query_failed"` | `lookup_failed detail=checks` | | j | `_pr_checks_completed` fails for any other reason | `checks_not_green` | | k | `compute_cycle_integration_ahead_by` leaves `CWS_AHEAD_BY` non-numeric | `lookup_failed detail=compare` | | k | `CWS_AHEAD_BY` is `0` | `not_ahead` | When every check passes, the resume runs in this order: - (l) **Persist state** with one atomic jq write: - `status = "validating"`, `final_merge_status = "pending"`, `final_merge_attempt_count = 0`, `final_merge_failure_kind = null`; - append head to `final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas` (dedupe, keep the last 20); - set `final_merge_auto_resumed_at_utc`. - On write failure: `rm -f` the tmp file, emit `::warning::`, log `outcome=skip reason=lookup_failed detail=state_write`, return 1. Labels and status stay unchanged. - (m) **Labels:** - `set_tracking_phase_label "ai:validated"`; the label contract drops `ai:blocked`, which is in the same phase group; - if `TRACKING_LABELS` has `ai:needs-human`, remove it with `gh_retry gh issue edit --remove-label` (warn on failure); - refresh `TRACKING_LABELS` with `get_issue_labels_json`, or edit it locally with jq if that fails, so the `ai:validated` gate in finalize sees the new label. - (n) **Notify:** `post_state_comment`, then one `post_tracking_comment` starting with `` and a "🔁 Final integration merge retried automatically" body that names the PR, the head and the switch. Then `tg_notify ... "DEBUG"`. - (o) **Log** `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME tracking_issue= outcome=resumed final_pr=

head_sha=`. - (p) **Retry:** read `VALIDATION_CYCLE` from `.validation_cycle // 1` (validated as an integer ≥ 1), clear `LAST_VAL_RAW_STATUS`/`LAST_VAL_CONCLUSION`, and call `mark_validation_complete "${VALIDATION_CYCLE}"`. Every existing gate applies: the security pass, the validation-history gate, required checks, ruleset blockers, the comprehensive promotion gate and the head-bound merge. Return 0. 5. **Terminal block** (around lines 28782–28802): after the force-merge bypass and before the `Project already ... skipping.` echo, add: `if [ "${PROJECT_STATUS}" = "failed" ] && maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted; then continue; fi` `needs_human_digest_prune` (called once per tick at line 23579) is unchanged. It drops the digest entry once `ai:needs-human` is gone. ## Data structures affected New fields in the tracking state blob. They are additive; missing means none. | Field | Type | Written when | |---|---|---| | `final_merge_failure_kind` | `"final_merge_exhausted"` or null | set on exhaustion, cleared on resume and on success | | `final_merge_exhausted_head_sha` | 40-hex or `""` | set on exhaustion | | `final_merge_exhausted_at_utc` | ISO-8601 UTC string | set on exhaustion | | `final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas` | array of 40-hex, last 20 kept | appended on each resume | | `final_merge_auto_resumed_at_utc` | ISO-8601 UTC string | set on each resume | New shell global: `FINAL_MERGE_LAST_PR_HEAD_SHA`. No DB. ## API or interface changes - **New env var** `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED`, default `true`; `false` restores today's behaviour. Wired as `FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED: ${{ vars.FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME_ENABLED || 'true' }}` in both poller env blocks of `orchestrate_poll.yml`, next to `SECURITY_PASS_AUTO_RESET_ON_ENGINE_CHANGE` (lines 1375 and 1596).
